name: Wallos
author: Miguel Ribeiro
description:
Wallos is a self-hosted tracker for personal subscriptions: renewal dates, costs per period, categories, payment methods and multi-currency conversion, with notifications before a renewal.

Fork of the official Runtipi app store definition, identical except for supported_architectures: upstream declares amd64 only, while bellamy/wallos publishes an arm64 image (verified: it pulls as arm64/linux on an aarch64 SBC). Without arm64 declared, Runtipi refuses to install with APP_ERROR_ARCHITECTURE_NOT_SUPPORTED.
